text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Since the 1990s it has been usual for the President of the Swiss Confederation to go on official visits abroad.", "gist": "Swiss Confederation President has routinely made official foreign visits since the 1990s."}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "The president is also responsible for fostering relations with the cantons.", "gist": "Swiss president must foster relations with the cantons."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "A Swiss president never pays a state visit, but can still be received for a state visit by a host country.", "gist": "Swiss president never initiates a state visit but can be hosted for one by another country."}, {"type": "other", "quote": "How is that possible?", "gist": "Question posed about the apparent contradiction in Swiss state visit protocol."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The question of state visits abroad frequently causes a certain amount of confusion.", "gist": "State visit protocol abroad often causes confusion."}]}
